svg.aria-label: All of it on one box: the laptop's bmesh serve embeds the NATS hub. The coordinator starts two leads, the box's cap; task-1's xcode check runs on the same box; task-2 queues one too and waits on the hub while the routine is busy, then runs once it's free, and lands first; the freed slot starts task-3, which depends on task-1, so the coordinator holds it until task-1 lands, then releases it; each land moves the checkout and is pushed to the phone
svg.title: buildermesh across boxes: one
